subject: gk
question: Under which Article of the Constitution of India shall the Governor of a State be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal?
solution: The correct answer is __**155**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Under article **155 of the Indian Constitution** **of India**, the Governor of a State shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.
